title: Terraform AWS Data Platform
description: S3 buckets with lifecycle + encryption, Glue catalogue, IAM roles scoped to least privilege, and Athena workgroups with query limits.
repo_structure:
terraform-aws-data-platform/
  modules/
    s3/       # versioning, SSE-KMS, lifecycle
    glue/     # catalog + crawlers
    iam/      # least-privilege roles
    athena/   # workgroup + bytes-scanned limit
  main.tf
  variables.tf
